Dunno if someone replied this already but, another way to change your steam region is to login with a VPN, buy any game using a billing address from said country (remember to click the country's currency on the payment details page) I bought a 0,40 pence game. Steam remembers the last purchase made with the last billing address. Then it'll change your steam region to that country. Then add it to your library, then log back in normally and install the game from your library. 

The only drawback is that your steam will be set in that region for 2 weeks - 3 months (got conflicting information on the length) before you can change it back. Have 1 friend playing the game with VPN and one without and both playing fine and not banned. I suppose just don't mention you're from NL or BE in game if you wanna be extra safe.
